To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a network that carries both interand intra-tenant traffic can be shared by using the least-paying of the communication partners as the basis for the allocation, and that this allocation, in conjunction with careful VM placement and traffic engineering, can help tenants obtain minimum bandwidth guarantees while also bounding their maximum impact.

(1) the least-paying of communicating entities should dictate the cloud network allocation; (2) this, when combined with VM placement, achieves complementary goals of providing minimum bandwidth guarantees and limiting the maximum network impact; and (3) minimum bandwidth guarantees help tenants achieve predictable performance while limiting the network impact helps mitigate malicious behavior.

(1) cloud network sharing should be dictated by the tenant that is least-paying of its communication partners; (2) careful VM placement is necessary to achieve the above; (3) minimum bandwidth guarantees, while providing tenants with predictable performance, also increase overall network utilization; and (4) bounding a tenant’s network impact mitigates malicious network behavior.

the design of a network sharing mechanism that can be deployed on existing cloud infrastructures and that can be used to share the network with a variety of tenants.
how to share a cloud network in the presence of inter-tenant traffic.
understanding the impact of richer inter-tenant communication on cloud network sharing and designing a practical solution that is both fair and efficient.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a cloud network should be shared in a way that is fair to all tenants, and not just those with the most money.
a cloud network’s sharing strategy can be used to achieve complementary objectives, and that a cloud network can be designed to support such sharing.
the cloud network should be shared based on least-paying partners, which is a simple, practical, and effective approach for cloud network sharing.
